steps.prompt: Without tools, find the remainder of 7 to the power 13 modulo 97 by repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply the previous remainder by 19 and reduce modulo 97. Explain briefly.
Without tools, independently work out the remainder of 11 to the power 9 modulo 101 using repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply that last remainder by 23 and reduce modulo 101. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, independently find the remainder of 5 to the power 11 modulo 89 using repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply that last remainder by 31 and reduce modulo 89. Give the result and finish with FLASH-SWITCHBACK-V1-DONE.
